sources.title: AI-Powered Hausa Text-to-Speech Model. - GitHub
sources.snippet: This repository houses the development of a cutting-edge AI-powered Text-to-Speech (TTS) model tailored for the Hausa language. The project aims to create a state-of-the-art TTS system through iterative development, rigorous testing, and collaboration among machine learning engineers, data scientists, linguists, and software developers.
